passages.text: The first-formed egg, then, warmed by the living creature within it, breaks open; next, once formed, the creature comes forth, just as Orpheus also says, “when the hard, capacious egg was split.” And so, when the one who had come forth appeared with great power, the shell receives its harmony and attains its ordered arrangement, while he himself sits foremost, as though on a ridge of heaven, and, among mysteries, illumines the boundless age from all sides. But as for the fertile matter left behind inside the shell: [ὡς ἐν πολλῷ τῷ χρόνῳ ὑποκειμένης ἕως φυσικῆς], the heat simmering underneath separated the substances of all things. For its lower part had first sunk downward under its weight, like sediment. Because of its downward-dragging quality and because of the weighty and great mass of the substance lying beneath, they named it Pluto, declaring him to be king of Hades and the dead.

lexical_decisions.rationale: πρωτοσύστατον describes what was constituted or formed first; “primordial egg” is possible but less transparent.

lexical_decisions.chosen: when the hard, capacious egg was split
lexical_decisions.rationale: κραναίου is taken as “hard” or “hard-shelled,” while πολυχανδέος denotes great capacity; “wide-gaping” is another possible rendering of the latter.
κύτος denotes a hollow vessel or cavity; within the continuing egg imagery, “shell” best identifies the remaining enclosure.

lexical_decisions.chosen: sits foremost, as though on a ridge of heaven
lexical_decisions.rationale: προκαθέζεται indicates sitting before or foremost, while ἀκρώρεια denotes a ridge or height; “sits enthroned” and “highest ridge” would add implications not explicitly supplied.

lexical_decisions.source_quote: ἐν ἀπορρήτοις τὸν ἄπειρον περιλάμπων αἰῶνα
lexical_decisions.chosen: among mysteries, illumines the boundless age from all sides
lexical_decisions.rationale: ἀπόρρητα may be secret or ineffable things, hence “mysteries”; περιλάμπων may describe shining around something or illuminating it on every side.

lexical_decisions.source_quote: ὡς ἐν πολλῷ τῷ χρόνῳ ὑποκειμένης ἕως φυσικῆς
lexical_decisions.chosen: [ὡς ἐν πολλῷ τῷ χρόνῳ ὑποκειμένης ἕως φυσικῆς]
lexical_decisions.rationale: The exact Greek is retained as unresolved because no defensible continuous English meaning has been established for the selected reading. This is not a printed lacuna and no restoration is inserted into the translation.

lexical_decisions.source_quote: τὸ μὲν γὰρ κατώτερον αὐτῆς πρῶτον
lexical_decisions.chosen: For its lower part had first
lexical_decisions.rationale: κατώτερον is comparative, so “lower part” preserves its degree rather than strengthening it to “lowest part.”
ὁλκότης conveys a tendency to pull or weigh downward; “heaviness” is possible but would overlap with the following ἐμβριθές.

lexical_decisions.chosen: king of Hades and the dead
lexical_decisions.rationale: Both coordinated genitives are retained rather than treating “Hades” merely as an explanatory synonym for the dead.

source_issues.source_quote: ὡς ἐν πολλῷ τῷ χρόνῳ ὑποκειμένης ἕως φυσικῆς ὑποζέουσα ἡ θερμότης
source_issues.issue: The supplied, image-checked wording remains syntactically and contextually unresolved. Although ἕως can govern a genitive, φυσικῆς has no expressed feminine head or contextually secure substantival sense, and the referent or head associated with genitive ὑποκειμένης is not securely recoverable before nominative ἡ θερμότης introduces the subject of διέκρινεν. The exact unresolved portion is therefore retained in Greek in the blocked draft rather than given unsupported English. Conjecturing ἕως as ὕλης would allow φυσικῆς to modify ὕλης and yield approximately “as natural matter lay beneath over a long time, the heat simmering underneath,” but this changes the selected reading and still leaves an irregular relation to the preceding topical ὕλη. Because no defensible continuous rendering of the printed construction has been established without conjectural alteration, publication remains blocked.
source_issues.proposed_reading: ὡς ἐν πολλῷ τῷ χρόνῳ ὑποκειμένης ὕλης φυσικῆς ὑποζέουσα ἡ θερμότης
